# Snowflake data quality

Before proposing quality rules, read and apply the
[full quality guidance](../../../skills/snowflake-data-quality/SKILL.md).
Resolve this link relative to this file. It is the source of truth for this
skill, including enforcement distinctions and monitoring cost.

Use evidence and the data owner's contract to choose thresholds. Do not
enable scheduled monitoring or discard failing records without agreement.
